user.title: Casa Energy — New instance
user.description: Give this configuration a name (useful if in the future you want to track multiple meters, e.g. Home and Office).

energy_sensors.title: Energy consumption sensors
energy_sensors.description: Select one or more sensors with device_class 'energy' whose monthly history you want to track. For each one, the power sensor (Watts) of the same device will be identified automatically to calculate instant power: you don't need to select it again.

ambiguous_power.title: Choose the power sensor
ambiguous_power.description: The device '{device_name}' (energy sensor: {energy_entity}) has more than one power sensor. Choose which one to use for the total calculation, and the name to display this load with.

unmatched_power.title: Power sensor not found
unmatched_power.description: No matching power sensor (Watts) was found for these devices: {devices}. They won't be counted in the total instant power until you add a power sensor to that device. Check the box to proceed anyway accepting this limitation, or go back and review your selection.

data.ignore_unmatched_power: Proceed anyway (these devices won't count toward the total)

power.title: Instant power
power.description: Configure your meter/system's maximum power and alert thresholds. Total instant power is calculated by summing the power sensors automatically matched to the energy sensors selected earlier.

add_display_load.title: Devices to display separately ({count} added)
add_display_load.description: Optional. Add devices here that you want shown as a separate item in the card, but that should NOT be summed into the total (e.g. if they're already included in one of the previous loads). Leave empty and continue to finish setup.

data.name: Device name
data.add_another: Add another device after this one

error.no_energy_sensors: Select at least one energy sensor.
error.unmatched_power_sensors: Some devices don't have a matched power sensor. Check the box to proceed anyway, or review your energy sensor selection.
error.duplicate_entity: This sensor has already been added to this list.
